आव॑ pron. st. of 1^st pers. du.
1 अवंश m. low (lit. no) family.
2 अवंश॑ n. the sky (lit. what has no beams or support).
अवकर m. dust, sweepings, rubbish.
अवकर्त m. piece cut off.
अवकर्तन n. cutting off.

अवकाश॑ m. open place, space, room, free course or scope,
interval, while, time. opportunity of (gen.).
अवकाशद a. giving room or shelter.

अवकीर्णिन् a. = prec. act.;
 unchaste, incontinent.
अवकीर्णिव्रत n. penance for incontinency.

अवकृष्ट a. drawn down, being below or under (—˚);
remote, inferior, low.
अवकृष्टजाति a. of a low(er) caste.
अवक्रचेतस् a. of upright mind.

अवक्रय m. letting or hiring out;
 rent, price.
अवक्षा॑ण a. burnt down.
अवक्षुत a. sneezed upon.
अवक्षेप m. derision, scoff, sarcasm.
अवक्षेपण n. throwing down, also = the prec.
अवखाद॑ m. devouring, wasting, destruction.
अवगम m. ˚न n. understanding, knowledge.

अवगाढ a. entered (act. & pass.), immersed (l.&f.),
depressed, deep.
अवगाह m. ˚न n. submersion, bathing.
अवगुण्ठन n. veiling, a veil. ˚वन्त् veiled.
†अवच a. lower (only in उच्चावच॑ q.v.).
अवचन a. speechless, silent.
अवचनीय a. not to be spoken, (blameless.*).
अवचय m. gathering, plucking.
अव˚चाय m. gathering, plucking.
अवच्छन्न a. covered over, overspread, filled.
अवच्छात a. emaciated, thin.

अवच्छेद m. cutting off, part cut off, piece;
separation, distinction.
अवज्ञा f. ˚न n. contempt.
अवञ्चक a. not a deceiver.*

अवट॑ m. hole, pit;
 a. ˚य्य॑ being in a pit.
अवटु m. or f. neck.
अवत॑ m. well, cistern.
अ॑वत्त a. cut off, divided.
1 अ॑वात a. unconquered, secure.
2 अवात॑ a. not windy. n. calm.
अवतंस m. garland or ear-ring.

अवतंसक m. the same, as adj. (f. ˚सिका) crowned
with (—˚).
अवतंसनीय a. to be made into a garland.*
अवतंसय् अवतंस˚यति make into a garland.*
अवतंसिनी f. wearing a garland of flowers.*
अवतरण n. descending, alighting.
अवतर॑म् adv. further away.
अवताडन n. pounding, crushing.
अ॑वतान्त a. faint, feeble.

अवतीर्ण a. come down, descended (cf. prec.) from (abl.
or —˚), in consequence of or in the shape of (—˚), fallen or got into
(acc.).
अवत्सल a. not tender, cruel to (loc.).
अवदात a. clean, pure, white, clear.
1 अवदा॑न n. cutting off or a part cut off.
2 अवदान n. heroic deed, exploit.
अवदावद a. undisputed, indisputable.
अवदीर्ण a. perplexed, bewildered.

अवद्य a. blamable, bad. n. imperfection, want, fault;
blame, censure, blemish, disgrace.
1 अवध m. no murder.
2 अवध॑ a. inviolable.
अवधान n. attention, devotion.

अवधारण n. ascertainment, strict determination,
restriction.

अवधि॑ m. limit, term, period. अवधि (—˚) & ˚धेस्
(gen. or —˚) till, as far as.
अवधीरण n. ˚णा f. disregard, contempt.
अवधीरय् अवधीर˚यति despise, reject.

अ॑वधूत a. shaken off, removed, rejected, spurned^1,
tossed, trodden upon, unclean.

अवधूनन n. shaking.
अवध्य॑ a. not to be killed, inviolable.
अवध्य॑ता n. inviolability.
अवध्य˚त्व n. inviolability.
अवध्यभाव m. the same.
अवध्र॑ a. indelible.
अवन n. favour, grace, protection.
अवनत a. bent down, deepened, not projecting.

अवनति f. stooping, setting;
 humiliation.
अवनिप m. king.
अवनि˚पति m. king.
अवनि˚पाल m. king.
अवने॑ग्य a. fit for washing.

अ॑वन्त् a. favourable, kind;
 N. of a man.
अवन्ति m. pl. N. of a people.
अवन्ती f. N. of the capital of the Avan.
अवपतित a. on what something (—˚) has fallen.
अव˚पन्न a. on what something (—˚) has fallen.
अवपा॑न n. drinking or giving to drink.

अवपात m. downfall, descent;
 a pit for catching game in.
अवपातन n. felling, throwing down.
अ॑वबाढ a. uncovered.

अवबोध m. waking;
 perception, understanding, knowledge.
अवबोधक a. awakening.
अवभङ्ग m. ˚भञ्जन n. breaking, splitting.

अवभासिन् a. shining, bright;
 enlightening, manifesting.
अवमन्तृ m. despiser (w. acc.).
अवमन्यक (—˚) a. despising, rejecting.

अवमर्श m. contact, touch;
 reflection, consideration.

अवमान m. ˚मानन n., ˚मानना f. disrespect,
contempt.
अवमानिन् a. despising, contemning.

अवयव m. limb, member;
 p. ˚विन्.
अवयवधर्म m. the figure of pars pro toto.
अवयवरूपक n. two kinds of comparison.
अवयवविरूपक n. two kinds of comparison.
अ॑वयातहेळस् a. whose wrath is appeased.
आवार m. guard, protection.
अ॑वरुद्ध a. checked, stopped, imprisoned.

अ॑वरूढ a. descended;
 put down or taken off (load).
अ॑वरेण (instr. as prep.) under (acc.).

अवरो॑धन n. the same;
 interior, sanctuary.
अवरोह m. descent (fig.).

अव॑रोहण f. ई descending;
 n. descent (l.&f.).
अवरोहिन् a. descending (lit. & fig.).
अवर्तमान a. not taking place, not present.
अ॑वर्ति f. want, need (lit. going down).
अवर्त्र॑ a. unchecked.
अवर्ष n. want of rain, drought.
अवर्ष˚ण n. want of rain, drought.
अवलग्न a. hanging down, hanging on (—˚).

अवलम्ब a. hanging down;
 m. = seq. n.
अवलम्बित = prec. adj.
अवलम्बिन् = prec. adj.

अवलिप्त a. haughty;
 abstr. ˚ता f., ˚त्व n.
अवलीन a. sitting, cowering, hidden in (loc or —˚).
अवलेप m. ˚न n. = prec. abstr. + ointment.
अवलोक m. ˚न n. sight, seeing.
अवलोकयितृ m. looker on, spectator.
अवलोकिता f. a woman's name.
अवलोकिन् a. seeing, looking at (—˚).
अवस॑ n. refreshment, food.
अ॑वसा f. rest, liberation.

आवास m. dwelling, abode;
 p. ˚सिन्.
अवशक f. ˚शिका the same.*
अवशग a. not subject or submissive to (gen.).
अवशान्त a. extinct.
अवशिन् a. having no (own) will, dependent.

अवशिष्ट a. left, remaining from (gen. or —˚), having
only (instr. or —˚) left.
अवशीर्ण a. decayed, shattered.

अवशेष m. rest, remainder;
 abstr. ˚ता f.
अवश्यकता f. अवश्यभाव m. necessity.
अवश्यभाविन् a. what must be.
अवश्याय m. frost, rime.

अवष्टब्ध a. standing firm, reclining, leaned upon
(act. & pass.), seized, taken, held.
अवष्टम्भमय a. confident, bold (arrow).

1 अ॑वस् n. favour, aid, assistance, recreation, relief,
comfort, joy, inclination, desire.
अवसा॑न n. resting-place, rest, end, death.

अवसर m. opportunity, occasion, right moment to (gen. or
—˚).
अवस॑र्पण n. descent.
अवसातृ॑ m. deliverer.
अवसाद m. sinking, decline, weakness, defeat.

अवसाय m. stopping, settling down;
 a. ˚यिन्.

अवसितकार्य a. satisfied (lit. who has done his
duty).*

अवसितमण्डन a. entirely dressed (lit. whose
toilet is completed).*
अवसुप्त a. asleep.
अवसेक m. sprinkling, bleeding.

अवसेचन n. the same;
 wash-water (cf. पादा-वसेचन).
अवस्कन्द m. assault, attack.

अवस्त्र a. unclothed;
 abstr. ˚ता f.
अवस्थान्तर n. altered condition, alteration.*
अवस्थिति f. abode, stay.
†अवस्पर्तृ m. deliverer.
अवस्य॑न्त् a. seeking favour or help.
अव˚स्यु॑ a. seeking favour or help.
अवस्रुत a. flowed down.
अ॑वस्वन्त् a. striving, eager.
अवहनन n. trashing, husking.

अवहास m. jest, joke;
 ˚सार्थम् for jest.

अ॑वहित a. put down, fallen into (esp. the water);
absorbed, attentive.
अवाक्शाख a. having the branches downwards.
अवाक्शिरस् a. having the head downwards. headlong.
अवाग्गमनवन्त् a. moving downwards.

अवाङ्मनसगोचर a. not within the reach of
language or intellect.

अवाङ्मुख f. ई looking or turned (lit. having the face
t.) downwards.
अवाची॑न a. directed downwards, lying under (abl.).
अवाच्य a. unspeakable, not to be spoken to.
अवाच्यवाद m. a forbidden word.

अ॑वाञ्च् f. अ॑वाची directed downwards, lower. n. अवाक्
downwards, headlong.
अवान्तरदेश॑ m. intermediate region (cf. दिश्).
अवाप्त a. (having) reached or obtained.
अवाप्ति f. acquirement, getting.

अवाप्य a. to be obtained;
 due to (—˚).
अवारणीय a. not to be stopped.
आव॑त् f. proximity (opp. परावत्).
आवन्तक a. belonging to or coming from the Avantis.
आव˚न्तिक a. belonging to or coming from the Avantis.

आवन्त्य a. the same;
 m. a cert. caste.
आवय॑ n. conception.
आवर्जन n. conciliating, winning.
आवलि f. row, range, series.
आव˚ली f. row, range, series.
आवल्गित a. jumping, leaping.
आव˚ल्गिन् a. jumping, leaping.
आवसति॑ f. resting-place, night (as the time for rest).
आवसथ॑ m. dwelling-place, habitation.
आवह a. bringing, causing (—˚).
आवाह m. ˚न n. invitation.
आवहन n. bringing near.
*आवापक m. a kind of bracelet.
